About this event

🚀 Mastering CoCo at Scale: Driving Value with Smart Usage & Cost Governance

Join Snowflake Senior Solution Engineer Speaker Name for a practical, step-by-step playbook on user governance, cost controls, and monitoring for CoCo (formerly Cortex Code).

Designed to help you establish controlled execution from day one, this session will give you the exact framework needed to manage scale securely. Don't miss this opportunity to learn directly from a Snowflake expert, network with peers, and level up your platform skills.

💡 What You Will Learn We will dive deep into key areas of cost governance, covering:

  • Core Governance Concepts: Budgets, quotas, per-user spending limits, resource and anomaly monitors, tag-based attribution, and chargeback/showback models.

  • Billing Mechanics: The ins and outs of token-based billing and understanding input vs. output costs.

  • Crucial Controls: How to properly gate client access using database roles, deploy spend alerts, and establish daily per-user credit limits to protect budgets.

  • Model Governance: Why model choice is your biggest financial lever, and how to build a secure RBAC model-tiering system into your deployments.

  • Value-Add Monitoring: How to query surface-specific usage history views and deploy an out-of-the-box Streamlit dashboard.

  • Rollout Pitfalls: The top oversights platform owners make and how to navigate around them.

🛠️ Equip Your Entire Team Invite your colleagues so your organization has a unified playbook for confident, scalable CoCo adoption.

RSVP today to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there!

Fuel for Your Creativity: We’ll provide complimentary food and drinks to keep the ideas flowing and the conversations going.

📋 Who Should Attend

This event is for anyone who loves to build, create, and innovate with data. Whether you’re a manager seeking to implement best practices, a seasoned architect, a data professional looking to streamline your workflows, or a developer just starting your learning journey, this is your opportunity to gain new skills, share ideas, and connect with a dynamic community.
